findings.title: Benchmark comes from a single household, so accuracy may not generalize to other cooks, plates and phones
findings.evidence: Owner decision 2026-09-28: only the owner collects the 300 weighed meals; ADR 0002 assumed 10-20 households

findings.title: Stop hook demanded a new handoff after merges because checkouts rewrite file mtimes
findings.evidence: After fast-forwarding T-004 (note already committed in the branch), the Stop hook blocked with handoff-missing; forcing a note on main diverges from active worktree journals
findings.resolution: Committed changes are now judged by commit ancestry (a note-adding commit must contain the last change); mtimes only for uncommitted files. Regression case added to harness/hooks/selftest-hooks.mjs

findings.title: CI red on main: hooks selftest copied a fixed list of repo-level files, so a new doc path (Pages workflow) failed D2 inside the test repo
findings.evidence: macrofy-harness runs 20-21 failed: harness-hooks-selftest, D2 on SPEC-T-012 mentioning the Pages workflow; the orchestrator had run only the fast gate after merging
findings.resolution: selftest-hooks copies .claude/ and .github/ whole (minus worktrees); full mc check now required after every merge (CLAUDE.md); filter matches paths relative to the copied folder so it also works inside agent worktrees

findings.title: 55 of 73 densities are FNDDS chopped-pieces packing densities, which understate solid items (e.g. steak ~1.0-1.1 g/mL)
findings.evidence: T-005 review (#50): kind flag present on all entries (55 pieces, 18 served); estimator must not apply pieces densities to solid outlines; T-013 (uncalibrated estimator): web/estimate/core.mjs now uses a solid-density prior (1.05 g/mL, an assumption in web/estimate/priors.json) for pieces-kind densities of solid groups (grilled or fried meat, fish, egg, fruit, cheese) and keeps the vocab density for served kinds and loose foods; the vocab densities themselves are unchanged and the prior awaits calibration on weighed meals

findings.title: Safari tab killed on the iPhone 16e while loading the first segmentation candidate (memory): auto mode needs SAM on this phone
findings.evidence: Owner feasibility run, iPhone 16e, Safari 26.6.2, WebGPU true: depth (onnx-community/depth-anything-v2-small, webgpu fp16) ok, 49.6 MB, load 12.5 s, cached 0.3 s, infer median 926 ms; segmentation: the tab was killed while loading the first candidate (SAM 2.1 tiny, the largest, with depth still resident; model null, tab_survived false); naming never reached. Most likely memory. Changes made under T-014: segmentation candidates smallest first (SlimSAM q8, then SAM 2.1 tiny q8/fp16, never fp32); the feasibility page runs each stage in its own page load and, after a crash, resumes with the next candidate of the same stage; depth is informational and the verdict needs only segmentation and naming (summed median inference at most 2 s); the app loads one model at a time on iOS and resumes an estimate from IndexedDB after a reload. Still open until the owner re-runs the page on the phone and segmentation and naming load.
findings.resolution: Run 3 on the iPhone 16e: SAM 2.1 tiny webgpu/q4f16 (34 MB) loads and infers in 1.6 s, CLIP B/32 vision-only webgpu/q4f16 (53 MB) in 0.12 s; verdict go. The app now tries these proven combinations first (web/lib/models.mjs PROVEN_ATTEMPTS) so users never crash-test

findings.title: Feasibility crash-resume skipped the remaining backends of a crashed model, so the WASM path for SAM was never tried
findings.evidence: Owner run 2 (research/device-runs/2026-09-29-iphone16e-feasibility.json): only webgpu attempts listed for slimsam and sam2.1, then the stage ended; the T-014 review had judged the resume logic loop-safe but did not check that every backend is attempted
findings.resolution: T-015 per-attempt resume: run 3 tried the SAM WASM attempt (crashed, recorded) and continued to the next attempt of the same stage, which loaded
